subject: Business Models
title: Creator Economy Models
description: A micro-lesson that makes Creator Economy Models usable.

hook.text: MrBeast earns $80 million/year from YouTube. He's not a company—he's one person with a camera and a model.

buildup.text: Creators monetize through ads, sponsorships, merchandise, courses, memberships, and direct fan payments.

discovery.text: Platforms like Substack and Patreon let creators earn directly. 1,000 true fans paying $100/year = $100K income.

twist.text: Platform dependency is the trap. YouTube can demonetize or ban creators overnight. The model has no safety net.

climax.text: The creator economy is worth $250 billion. Individual creators are becoming media companies.

punchline.text: $80M from videos. Creators are the new media companies.

quiz.question: What risk do creators face in the creator economy?
options: Platform dependency—they can be demonetized overnight
